jobs.details: Civilian Direct Recruitment Board, ASC Centre (South) Bangalore invites offline applications for 62 Group C posts: Fireman (24), Leading Fireman (14), Tradesman (08), Civilian Motor Driver (06), Civilian Catering Instructor (03), Fire Engine Driver (03), Cook (02), Cleaner (02) and MTS (01). Download the application form, attach self-attested testimonials and send it by post to The Presiding Officer, Civilian Direct Recruitment Board, Civ CR ASC Centre (South), Agram Post, Bangalore - 560007 so that it reaches on or before 04-09-2026 (05:00 PM). Selection is through PET/PST, Trade Test, Written Test, Document Verification and Medical Examination.
howToApply: Download the offline application form using the link below.
Read the official notification for eligibility, age relaxation, documents and the postal address.
Fill the form and attach self-attested testimonials, a recent photograph and a Rs. 25 stamped postal card.
Send the completed application by post to The Presiding Officer, Civ CR ASC Centre (South), Agram Post, Bangalore - 560007 before 04-09-2026.
